newsitem.title: UK: European cotton mills await further price news.
newsitem.headline: European cotton mills await further price news.

text.p: Despite the generally firmer undertone in the sellers' price ideas, most mills in Europe were content to await further developments before adding siqnificantly to existing inventory.

An uncertain autumn sales outlook for several descriptions of cotton and blended yam proved further impediment to new business. Turkey, however, remained in the market for selected foreignmedium/better staples and a retail business was under discussion in Portugal. The markets in eastern Europe lacked feature and the long staple sector was dull.
